thread:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up — Arcadia (preview cohort) signed up for 12 seats and wants first-run enablement next Tues. Saw an SSO hiccup in the intake form, flagging here.
ajay_growth: Nice. Do we have an onboarding checklist and webinar slots? I can host a short 30m product walkthrough. :raised_hands:
sophia_eng: Re: SSO — their IdP metadata had SP entity mismatch. I pushed a note to the integration ticket at 09:18. Can someone DM me the exact metadata they uploaded?
maria_cs: Copy — forwarding the intake PDF now. They uploaded the base64 cert blob instead of the XML metadata. I'll attach in the ticket.
onboard-bot: Reminder: Arcadia preview checklist 4/8 complete — pending: SSO verify, sample prompts, billing confirmation.
ajay_growth: We'll need to prioritize SSO verify before the webinar otherwise engineers can't join the hands-on. Tim, any capacity on Dedicated enablement this week?
tim_ops: I can carve out 45m on Mon afternoon to validate their connection and run a smoke test. Ping me the SP URL.
sophia_eng: SP URL is https://arcadia.example/saml/consume — sample error log below (they pasted):
```
ERROR saml: invalid_entity_id: expected https://redwood.example/sp got https://redwood/staging
```
This explains the mismatch. Maria, ask them to export the raw metadata XML from their IdP and resend.
maria_cs: On it. Also putting a soft hold on seat activation if they can't verify SSO by EOD Mon — they requested pre-provisioning which we should avoid until verified.
ajay_growth: Also flag this as a renewal-risk signal in our tracker: new account, heavy seat ramp, SSO friction = medium short-term churn risk. I'll add tag and owner.
onboard-bot: Action created: CS-1729 "Arcadia SSO verify" assigned to tim_ops, due 2026-04-13.
maria_cs: For feedback capture, let's send the micro-survey after the first enablement session (Qs: clarity, latency, docs). I suggest 3 q's + NPS. Who will draft?
ajay_growth: I can draft the survey copy tonight and share in #cs-templates. Keep it concise.
sophia_eng: After SSO confirm, I can provision a staging model variant with prefix cache enabled so they can test typical latency. Will note any config differences in the rollout doc.
maria_cs: Perfect. Action items: 1) Maria -> get raw metadata from Arcadia (owner: maria_cs) 2) Tim -> smoke test SSO Mon (tim_ops) 3) Ajay -> draft survey + schedule 30m webinar (ajay_growth) 4) Sophia -> prep staging variant and notes (sophia_eng). I'll follow up with a brief recap in the customer record.
ajay_growth: tiny ask — can we include a one-pager about seat-swapping and cost expectations for preview customers? Arcadia asked about flexible seat usage for pilots.
sophia_eng: I'll add an operations note explaining burst capacity and expected per-token costs for the preview config.
maria_cs: Thanks team. If SSO verification fails Monday I'll propose a temporary personal-access flow for the webinar so they can still join hands-on. Will update thread with receipt of metadata. :thumbsup:
onboard-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up ping to maria_cs in 24h regarding metadata receipt.
